text:
maya: Quick API Q — prefix cache hit signaling and TTL derivation. We currently emit `X-Cache-Hit: true` and `Cache-Control: max-age=...`, but streaming partial-prefix hits are ambiguous. If we stream cached prefix then fetch rest, how should clients detect partial vs full? Also: TTL computation takes model.default_ttl and user max_age; do we need to expose derived_ttl for debugging? Anyone?

ryan: We talked about this in the last sync. We were leaning toward a three-state hit header rather than boolean — e.g. `X-Cache-Hit: full|partial|miss`. But that will break SDKs that expect boolean. Could we add `X-Cache-Hit-Mode: v1` and keep boolean for v0? :thinking:

nora: Important: mobile + JS SDKs treat any truthy header as cache hit and adjust UI. We should avoid changing the boolean semantics. Option: keep `X-Cache-Hit` as `true|false` and add `X-Cache-Hit-Detail: partial, bytes=1024` for extra info. Backcompat win.

lee: Ops note: partial hits during streaming are tricky — we either send a separate event at stream end or include a header at the start with `X-Cache-Prefix-LEN` so clients know how much was served from cache. Example header: `X-Cache-Prefix-Len: 1024` (bytes). Clients can then decide when to show "cached" badge. 

dev-bot: docs: new PR created https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1243 — includes header proposals + examples. :link:

jon: Agree with nora + lee. Proposed minimal change:
```
# headers (backwards compatible)
X-Cache-Hit: true|false
X-Cache-Prefix-Len: <int>    # optional, only present if prefix cache used
X-Cache-Hit-Detail: full|partial|miss  # optional for richer clients
```
Also add `Derived-TTL` header when feature-flagged: `Derived-TTL: 3600` so debugging tools can show the value used.

maya: That looks good. A few followups: 1) How do we treat streaming chunked responses where prefix is only first N tokens? Should `X-Cache-Prefix-Len` be bytes or tokens? Need to pick one. 2) Schema for `X-Cache-Hit-Detail` values — use `partial` vs `inflight` vs `stale`?

nora: Prefer tokens for SDK UX (we show token counts). Servers can emit `X-Cache-Prefix-Tokens` for token count and `X-Cache-Prefix-Len` for bytes. Both optional.

lee: For invalidation, when prompt changes we already bump prefix namespace version. Ops will emit `Cache-Invalidation: ns=prefix_v42;reason=prompt-update` to the audit logs but not to clients. Should we emit `X-Cache-Invalidated: true` when a request misses due to recent invalidation? Probably noisy.

ryan: For rollout: feature-flag `prefix-cache.headers.v2` will gate `X-Cache-Hit-Detail` and `Derived-TTL`. Default off. SDKs can opt-in.

maya: Action items: 
- ryan: add feature-flag + implement boolean header + optional detail header (ETA end of week)
- nora: update mobile & JS SDKs to tolerate new optional headers (PR link pls)
- lee: add `X-Cache-Prefix-Tokens` instrumenting to runtime and post rollout monitor
- jon: add Derived-TTL to debug header behind flag

maya: ping @sdk-team for visibility :eyes:

sdk-team: noted, we will add tolerant parsing and show token counts when header present. Will follow PRs.

maya: Thanks all — will merge docs PR after SDK thumbs-up. :rocket:
